scripts.dev:db: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dockerReady = $false; if (-not (Get-Process 'Docker Desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process 'C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe' }; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 120; $i++) { docker info > $null 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $dockerReady = $true; break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; if (-not $dockerReady) { Write-Error 'Docker Desktop did not become ready in time.'; exit 1 }; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres"
scripts.dev: npm run dev:db && concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.e2e: node scripts/healthz.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e:container
scripts.verify: npm run docker:up && node scripts/healthz.mjs && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e:container
scripts.audit:prod: npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
